The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''25,801 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as '''10,662 after the Tho Yor Arrival''', was a year in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic history]]. That year, the [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Vulk]] died in a [[Cloud Chaser]] crash on [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]].<ref name="DOTJ">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>
